value.title: Weepy Old Killer
value.synopsis: Mihai's story. It's about his life as a hitman, what happened to the one woman he loved, and how he faced a demon born through his training.

value.title: Gun Smoker
value.synopsis: Badou's story. A hilarious story about how he's chased all around the city for taking a picture of a gang lord doing something really embarrassing. you figure out whether he has the guts to take a beating at the end of the chapter.

value.title: Blade Maiden
value.synopsis: Naoto's story. It explains why she's so vengeful, how she got her training with the sword, and how she got the scar on her chest.

value.title: Stray Dogs Howling in the Dark
value.synopsis: Haine's story. He is touched by a rare sense of heart when he sees a winged girl bought by some rich man and tries to save her.
